name: affine-connector
description: Full AFFiNE MCP and API workspace access for ChatGPT through the shared Bratonien MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Use native AFFiNE MCP tools and the complete authenticated AFFiNE API surface.
interface.longDescription: Bridges the complete native AFFiNE workspace MCP dynamically into the shared Bratonien MCP server and adds a controlled same-origin /api/* passthrough for API endpoints not represented as native MCP tools. AFFiNE remains responsible for authentication and effective permissions.
defaultPrompt: Update or delete this AFFiNE document for me.
